_readme: Each entry in 'jobs' is one Android API level. Everything for a job lives in build/API_<n>/ :
download/  (platform zip, JDK archive, hiddenapi csv ...)   tools/android/  tools/jdk/   00_setup/ ... 21_cpp_emit/
api_versions_xml : 'auto' (look inside the extracted platform: android-<n>/data/api-versions.xml, error if missing)
| 'skip' | a direct https URL (downloaded) | a local file path
hiddenapi_flags  : a direct https URL | 'skip' | a local file path
jdk.url          : one URL, or a dict keyed by 'windows-x64', 'linux-x64', 'darwin-aarch64' ... (falls back to 'windows'/'linux'/'darwin'/'default')
jdk.path         : optional, use an already-unpacked JDK folder instead of downloading
stages           : set a stage to false to skip it (its inputs must already exist from an earlier run)
zip_dir / zip_name : REQUIRED per job. Where the final zip of the package.py 'stratum/' folder is written. Placeholders: {api}, {api_dir} (= build/API_<n>), {build_root}.
A <zip_name>.sha256 file is written next to it (handy for a release page).
Stage commands match the manual 'run commands' list exactly; only stage 00 differs (it receives the auto-downloaded jar/jdk/xml/csv paths).
Downloads are resumable (.part files), retried, verified, and never repeated when a verified file is already present.

jobs._comment: Example second API. Disabled. Fill in the hiddenapi URL that matches API 34 (or keep 'skip'), and pick the JDK that built this android.jar.
